name: bua_analysis
description: Retrieves the current BUA state and standard campus biosafety practices, then passes both to the LLM to perform a compliance check and generate a Biosafety Audit Report.

inputs.name: focus_area
inputs.description: Specific area of the BUA to focus the analysis on (e.g., 'personnel training', 'biological agents', 'all'). Defaults to 'all'.

outputs.description: A dictionary containing the 'status', specific LLM 'instructions', 'campus_biosafety_practices' text, and 'current_bua_data'.

output.instructions: You are an expert Institutional Biosafety Committee (IBC) reviewer...
output.campus_biosafety_practices:
Common Biosafety Practices:
General lab protocol...
